name: Murasame Hakushuu
source:
Sakura's Mentor

A character that is a bit shrouded in mystery. Known to have been Sakura's mentor in swordsmanship.

[i]"Terrible puns? I'd prefer to say I have a penchant for wordplay."[/i]
